{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 2.14

|gr1= Curator

|descr= Set the list of objects in the given selection preset. Only [[Object]] is supported in selection presets, unlike [[curatorSelected]] which also returns the selected [[Group]], [[Waypoint]], and Marker [[String]]

|s1= numkey [[setCuratorSelectionPreset]] objects
|p1= numkey: [[Number]] - number key under which the selection preset is saved
|p2= objects: [[Array]] of [[Object]]s - objects to save to the selection preset
|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>1 setCuratorSelectionPreset [object1, object2];</sqf>

|seealso= [[curatorSelectionPreset]] [[loadCuratorSelectionPreset]] [[curatorSelected]] [[setCuratorSelected]] [[addCuratorSelected]] [[Arma 3: Curator]]
}}
